name: Being Born Again
overview: Scripture teaches that being born again is essential for entering the kingdom of God, as Jesus declares that no one can see or enter the kingdom without this new birth, which is described as being born of water and the Spirit. This spiritual rebirth grants believers the right and privilege to become children of God, made possible through faith in Jesus Christ. God's love is demonstrated in giving His only begotten Son so that whoever believes in Him will have eternal life, the gift that overcomes the wages of sin, which is death.
